notes: Each eval targets a failure this theme produces *with a green build*. An eval that only checks 'the build succeeded' proves nothing here. Field name is `query`: that is what run_eval.py reads (the plugin references say `prompt`, the code disagrees). **Every query names a concrete existing file.** Measured: queries saying "this page" left a fresh `claude -p` with no referent, so it correctly asked which page instead of authoring anything — testing whether it asks, not whether it picks the right component.

evals.query: Add a grid of three cards to exampleSite/content/docs/_index.md linking to the tokens, typography, and components pages.
evals.expected_output: A `cards` block wrapping three `card` calls, each using only parameters from the whitelist.
expectations: Uses `{{< cards >}}` … `{{< /cards >}}` as a pair, not self-closed
Each `card` uses only title, link, icon, badge, image, or image_alt
Does not invent parameters such as `description`, `text`, or `href`
Any `icon` value is a name from data/icons.json, not a CSS class or Font Awesome name

evals.query: In exampleSite/content/docs/components/book.md, add a cross-reference to the numbered figure from an earlier paragraph.
evals.expected_output: A self-closed `xref` with exactly one target kind.
expectations: Writes `{{< xref fig="…" />}}` self-closed, or paired only when supplying custom link text
Passes exactly one of fig, tbl, eq, eg — not several at once
Does not hand-write a label like "Figure 2", since xref generates it per locale

evals.query: Write a three-step install procedure to paste into exampleSite/content/docs/_index.md.
evals.expected_output: An ordered list carrying `{.steps}`, not the steps shortcode.
expectations: Uses an ordered list with `{.steps}` rather than `{{< steps >}}`
If it does use the shortcode, it states the specific reason (TOC entries or a container shortcode inside a step)
Does not self-close the container if the shortcode is used
If the steps describe installing this theme, they do not include `pnpm install` — measured failure: the model reached for a plausible install procedure instead of the one in commands.md

evals.query: Add a Mermaid flowchart of the theme's build pipeline to exampleSite/content/docs/components/diagram.md.
evals.expected_output: A fenced code block with language `mermaid`.
expectations: Uses a ```mermaid fence
Does not write `{{< mermaid >}}`, which fails the build with 'template for shortcode not found'
Any fence attributes are limited to caption, num, id, plus class/data-*/aria-*

evals.query: Add a PlantUML sequence diagram to exampleSite/content/docs/components/diagram.md.
evals.expected_output: A plantuml fence plus the server config it needs.
expectations: Uses a ```plantuml fence, not a shortcode
States that `params.ui.plantuml.server` must be configured or the fence renders only its source
Does not silently assume a default public server exists

evals.query: Show this project's directory layout in exampleSite/content/docs/tokens.md.
evals.expected_output: A filetree fence with box-drawing characters.
expectations: Uses a ```filetree fence
Does not write `{{< filetree >}}` — it is not a shortcode despite having a docs page
Uses box-drawing characters for the tree and `#` for trailing comments
Any attribute is `title`, the only one this fence accepts

evals.query: I'm starting a new site with this theme. Set it up so I can preview it.
evals.expected_output: hugo new site, a complete theme copy including data/, and the required markup config.
expectations: Copies layouts, assets, static, data, and i18n, plus hugo.toml and theme.toml
Explicitly includes data/ — omitting it silently drops every icon
Adds the five markup settings from config.md, not a subset
Does not run `hugo mod get` or add the theme to module.imports
Does not claim `pnpm dev` or `pnpm build` will build the user's own site
Does not require `pnpm install` in order to use the theme

evals.query: Code blocks stay light-coloured after switching to dark mode. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Identifies missing `noClasses = false` in the site's markup.highlight.
expectations: Names `[markup.highlight] noClasses = false` as the cause
Explains that Hugo ignores markup settings coming from a theme, so it must be in the site config
Does not propose editing the theme's CSS or the theme's own hugo.toml
Mentions that `noClasses = true` is Hugo's default, so this must be set explicitly

evals.query: Search returns nothing on my local dev server. What's wrong?
evals.expected_output: Explains that the Pagefind index does not exist under hugo server.
expectations: States that the index is built from public/ after Hugo runs, so it is absent under `hugo server`
Gives `npx pagefind --site public` as the step
Does not treat this as a theme bug or suggest changing search configuration

evals.query: Add a contributors section to a new page exampleSite/content/about.md.
evals.expected_output: The shortcode plus the data file it depends on.
expectations: Notes that a data/<key>.yaml file is required
Warns that without it the shortcode renders nothing while the build still succeeds
Does not claim the theme fetches contributors from an API

evals.query: I set the badge title with `titel=` by mistake and the build passed. Why didn't it fail?
evals.expected_output: Explains warn-plus-fallback, and how to make it fail.
expectations: Explains that unknown parameters warn and are ignored, leaving the build green
Recommends `hugo --printPathWarnings --panicOnWarning`
Notes that `badge` has no `title` parameter at all — the correct one is `text`, so fixing the typo to `title=` would not have helped either
Says the badge renders nothing rather than rendering empty — badge.html warns `needs a non-empty text; rendering nothing`

evals.query: Document these API fields in exampleSite/content/docs/components/field.md: name, timeout, retries.
expectations: Uses `fields` as the container and `field` for each entry
Uses only name, type, required, default on `field`
Does not self-close `fields`, which warns and renders nothing
Puts each field's prose in the body, since that is what gets rendered as Markdown

evals.query: Build a landing page for this site with a hero, a three-card section, and a pricing table.
evals.expected_output: Front matter with layout: landing and a sections array — no shortcodes.
expectations: Writes `layout: landing` plus a `sections:` array in front matter, not body content
Does not reach for `{{< cards >}}` or any shortcode on a landing page
Uses only keys listed in landing.md for each section type
Supplies every required key — `name` and `price` on a pricing entry, `title` on a card — since omitting one drops that entry silently

evals.query: My landing page's comparison table isn't showing up at all. The build succeeded.
evals.expected_output: Identifies a missing or empty required key on pricing-compare.
expectations: Names `plans` as the likely cause — it must be a non-empty array or the whole section renders nothing
Distinguishes section-level failure from per-entry failure, where a bad row is skipped and the rest renders
Does not treat a green build as evidence the front matter is correct

expectations: Does not load or cite this skill's reference files
